Por cada pulsación se registra el instan:
For each keystroke, the moment the key is pressed and released is recorded with microsecond precision. From that come the hold time of each key, the interval and the flight time between keys, the duration of digraphs and trigraphs, the use of shift, the mistakes and the way they are corrected.

To compare different texts, Gunetti and Picardi's R measure (relative order of key combinations from fastest to slowest) and A measure (difference in durations) are used, also on flight times, together with a statistical distance on the global features. Each user has their own threshold, calculated with leave-one-out validation (leave-one-session-out if there are several); if the sample is not within anyone's threshold, it is considered an unknown user. Samples with a robotic rhythm or that exactly repeat a stored one are also rejected.
